transfers.reasoning: APPROVED, independently of Gemini's reasoning (which was captain-driven and unsound). Kerkez is the clear sale on merit: 1 season pt, 160/180 mins, start_rate 0.89 (lowest in the squad), MC EV 2.64, 3.2% EO — pure dead weight. Kayode wins on BOTH axes the protocol trusts: season pedigree (15 pts vs 1) and this-week matchup (BRE at home to Sunderland, fdr 2 — Sunderland own the worst 3-GW run in the league at 4.27). fixture-room's LIV-best-run (2.60) argument is the one real counter, but a best-run fixture is worthless attached to a defender producing 0.5 ppg, and BRE's own run (3.13) is comfortably better than the tier the sale funds. The 0.9m banked is the first brick in the Haaland-funding wall (intel's rank_risk #1: 125% EO unowned, unbuyable at 15.5m this week).

chip.reason: No chip condition is met. WC needs 3+ rotation-flagged starters (we have zero after the gate) or a 3-GW rolling average under 55/GW — we are at 152 pts through 2 GWs (76.0/GW), nowhere near the trigger. Chips left: TC, FH, WC x2. 26/27 FORMAT NOTE: the first-half set expires at the GW19 deadline and does NOT carry over. projected_xpts_method: Sum of the 11 starters' calibrated MC expected values + B.Fernandes counted once more for the armband (50.34 + 8.76). Kayode is not in sim-lab's MC (unowned at run time) so he is estimated at 4.20 by deflating his cache xpts 4.77 toward the pool mean. IMPORTANT: I did NOT use raw cache/xpts.json for this total — that model is clean-sheet-weighted and systematically deflated (it prices B.Fernandes at 2.82 against an MC EV of 8.76, and Haaland at 1.80). Summing it yields ~24.7, less than half the 45-75 sanity band the protocol expects, which is itself proof the cache figures are not a points forecast. Gemini's 9.54 'projected_xpts' is not a squad projection at all — it is one player's doubled captain score.

risks.mitigation: ACCEPT, DO NOT COMPOUND. The one genuine error available here is fading B.Fernandes on top of it (Gemini's Kayode captaincy), which loses twice. Bank the 0.9m and treat Thiago (8.0m, 2 pts, 1.8 xG, 0 goals) as the GW4-6 funding lever.

Rogers is the only defensible fade at 25.6% EO, but his MC EV of 5.15 is the 3rd highest in the squad, so benching him is EV-negative. Hold both.
